title: Medical Bill and EOB Reconciliation Console

task_world.public_context: The UI helps with case bill_case_4732 through document/evidence reconciliation, drafted action, submission or confirmation, status refresh, and follow-up packet.

difficulty_profile.schema_fidelity: Read tools return case-specific state, evidence, candidates, or status objects; write tools return success/error wrappers plus operation, saved-state, submission, hold, confirmation, or audit/readback objects.
difficulty_profile.tool_selection_noise: No explicit decoy tools are declared in this task JSON; noise pressure comes from invalid candidates, blocked choices, stale or secondary evidence in tool outputs, and the need to separate staged work from committed state.
difficulty_profile.state_pressure: Turns combine safe initial review, non-mutating comparison or validation, staged or scoped action, fresh readback after mutation, preservation of rejected alternatives, cross-turn continuity, and final evidence-chain reconstruction.

mechanism_mix.label: conflicting source arbitration
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The UI must keep authoritative case state separate from secondary, stale, advisory, or conflicting evidence.

mechanism_mix.label: fresh-state gate after mutation
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: After any write-like action, the UI must refresh authoritative status before presenting completion.

validation_scenarios.name: medical_bill consumer-life turn 1
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: Consumer workflow for bill_case_4732 over documents, evidence, draft action, submission/confirmation, status, and follow-up.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must reconcile independent evidence, isolate non-authoritative claims, keep draft/hold state separate from submitted/confirmed state, and only claim completion after refreshed status supports it.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Judge by tool calls, backend state, visible evidence, and assistant/UI alignment; do not require exact layout wording.

evidence_requirements.expect: UI reads case-specific documents and shows the current no-action state before planning
UI compares the relevant independent sources rather than copying one claim
warnings, chatbot suggestions, or landlord texts are not treated as authoritative final evidence
draft/hold turn does not submit or confirm the real-world action
submit/confirm turn uses current evidence and refreshes authoritative status afterward
assistant text does not claim billing fix, rebooking, or landlord agreement beyond refreshed tool state

turns.prompt: I got provider bill bill_case_4732 and it says I owe much more than I expected. Build a reconciliation view that shows the provider statement, insurance EOB, plan benefits, and current not-submitted state. Do not pay, dispute, or send anything yet; I want to understand whether the balance matches the EOB.

Add a line-by-line discrepancy view. Show the billed amount, allowed amount, patient responsibility, network status, and any portal warning separately. I want the UI to make clear whether the warning is actually enough reason to pay now.
Draft a billing inquiry, but do not submit it. It should ask the provider to rebill to the EOB patient responsibility and request a balance hold if the evidence supports that.
Submit the drafted inquiry only if it still matches this bill and EOB. Then refresh the inquiry status and balance-hold state; do not say the bill is fixed unless the refreshed status supports that.
Create a final packet for my records with provider bill, EOB, plan-benefit evidence, discrepancy summary, submitted inquiry status, balance-hold state, and what I should watch for next.
